comments.text: Sharing 98.7% of our DNA, yet their society is led by females and they solve conflicts with peace and affection, not war. 🤯 Bonobos really prove that humanity has a choice! Who else is absolutely fascinated by our closest cousins in the animal kingdom? 🐒❤

replies.author: @BestTravelDocumentary4k
replies.text: "Such a fascinating perspective! Their peaceful social structure is truly unique in the animal kingdom. Thanks for sharing your thoughts!"
